verdict.rationale: Belvo is an open-finance data aggregator, so retrieving account-holder identity data is a fair axis for it. However, no evidence in the pack mentions owner or identity data such as names, addresses or contact details. The documented aggregation data covers transactions, balances, investments, employment, fiscal records and enrichment only.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can retrieve account-holder details — names, addresses, contact data on file at the bank — to match the account owner against my customer
